storm.label: Storm week
storm.notice: A severe storm has been forecast for today. Travel across the city is expected to be heavily disrupted. The city emergency management department has advised residents to limit travel as much as possible.

notes.routes: Routes are shortest paths on the OSM drive network, drawn for display; the engine uses straight-line travel.
notes.gaps: Trips whose logged travel exceeds 120 minutes follow a stretch the engine did not record (no stay logged); the agent is hidden during it.
